build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions for automatic differentiation with WFSTs
create_cmake_extension: create a CMakeExtension instance to define a C++ extension module for the gtn library
build_cmake_extensions: build CMake extensions for gtn including graph, autograd, utils, rand, creations, functions, and parallel modules
load_readme_description: load the README.md file to use as the long description for the gtn package metadata
configure_cmake_build: configure the CMake build process with python bindings enabled and examples, benchmarks, and tests disabled
